claims.text: The supplied pilot context identifies ED-CASE-REAL-01 as Donald Byrne, white, versus Bobby Fischer, black, in New York in 1956. Original historical authentication remains unverified.
claims.subject: ED-CASE-REAL-01
claims.confidence_rationale: Preserved source declaration; confidence not inferred from repetitions, legal status or research count.

claims.text: The supplied secondary candidate identifies 17...Be6 at ply 34, 18.Bxb6 at ply 35, and 25...Nxd1 at ply 50 as played moves on the real line. This declaration is not original 1956 source authentication.
claims.subject: MAIN
claims.confidence_rationale: Preserved source declaration; confidence not inferred from repetitions, legal status or research count.

claims.text: 17...Qd8 is the supplied alternative on ALT_QD8 and was not historically played. Its supplied position and move declaration do not establish independently verified chess legality.
claims.subject: 17...Qd8
claims.confidence_rationale: Preserved source declaration; confidence not inferred from repetitions, legal status or research count.

claims.text: The supplied R2 excerpt declares 26.h3 at ply 51 after 25...Nxd1 at ply 50. Accordingly, ply 50 is not the ending of the supplied candidate game.
claims.subject: 25...Nxd1
claims.confidence_rationale: Preserved source declaration; confidence not inferred from repetitions, legal status or research count.

claims.text: The supplied secondary PGN declaration places its terminal move at ply 82, 41...Rc2#. The original historical score and the full PGN have not been authenticated in this task.
claims.subject: SOURCE-R2-PGN
claims.confidence_rationale: Preserved source declaration; confidence not inferred from repetitions, legal status or research count.

claims.text: The supplied editorial sequence omits moves at plies 36 through 49 inclusive. V-PRE-EV2 is the technical-only destination position after ply 49; those omitted moves are not presented as shown events.
claims.subject: T10
claims.confidence_rationale: Preserved source declaration; confidence not inferred from repetitions, legal status or research count.

claims.text: T12 closes the editorial sequence at V-EV2 after ply 50. This editorial closure does not represent the historical game ending.
claims.subject: T12
claims.confidence_rationale: Preserved source declaration; confidence not inferred from repetitions, legal status or research count.
